 Close Main Menu Loading… Open Schedule Ticker Open Main Menu BYU Football Game Week 2026 — Baylor
 The Cougars are back home at LaVell Edwards Stadium to host the Baylor Bears on Saturday.
 Date November 09, 2026 Share Twitter Facebook Email PROVO, Utah — No. 12 BYU football hosts the Baylor Bears at LaVell Edwards Stadium on Saturday, November 14 at 1:30 p.m. MT. The game will be televised on FOX.
 Use this page as a one-stop shop throughout the week for everything related to the game. Updates will be made leading up to kickoff, including broadcast plans, news, fan events and game notes. 
 Game Info
 No. 12 BYU (7-2) vs. Baylor(6-3)
Saturday, November 14
Kickoff: 1:30 p.m. MT
